one_minute_value_explanation: AOF can now turn a real GitHub read into governed runtime evidence: provider, read-only adapter, observed repo/release/issue/PR/workflow data, decision, evidence refs, no-write boundary, and not-proven limits.
thirty_second_version_delta: v11.1 made AOF's next-task judgment reproducible by a human; v11.2 makes the upstream GitHub read itself a first-class audited runtime integration.
product_review_trigger: If the operator still cannot tell what provider was read, what output was observed, or whether writes were blocked, reopen provider read recognition design.
not_proven: This does not prove provider semantic truth, GitHub write safety, credential safety, production automation, market value, productivity gain, or broad adoption.
